items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: the early part of this year I went down to Wispering Pines with Doc Cheatham and Red Richards and Herb Hall and we made another album while we

ctx.x: -- recorded in 1978, called, "We Just Couldn't Say Goodbye."

Yeah, I had some friends for whom I used to go up to Manchester, New Hampshire, to do a concert with (inaudible) I might say and he would bring up people like Herb Hall and McK. Dickenson and Herman Autrey and Red Richards and then Joe Robertson, he was in the linen service. I imagine when he was younger he probably played a little trombone around Manchester and also he had a son going to Andover Academy up there. So he used to bring the groups up there to do a benefit for the school. So he retired and went down…
